normative_extracts.quote: A module namespace exotic object exposes indirect bindings to the Module Environment Record of the exporting module.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: ESM links imports as read-only indirect pointers into the exporting module's LexicalEnvironment before executing a single line of module code.

production_failures.symptom: ReferenceError: Cannot access export before initialization in circular imports
production_failures.root_cause: Module A imports a const/let binding from Module B, and B evaluates first and reads A's uninitialized TDZ export slot.
production_failures.mitigation: Break circular dependencies by extracting shared types/constants into a leaf module or deferring reads inside functions.

production_failures.symptom: Large ESM waterfall delays initial interactive render by 800ms+
production_failures.root_cause: Deeply nested unbundled module graphs require sequential HTTP round-trips unless preloaded.
production_failures.mitigation: Emit <link rel='modulepreload'> hints for critical entry chunks or bundle static subgraphs.
